svg.title: Robot Learning Lab: measured synthetic navigation experiment
svg.desc: Q-learning, BFS replanning and random policies on one fixed grid, with held-out action noise.
svg.text: Tabular Q-learning | finite horizon | stochastic action slip
One fixed map: first held-out episode
A blocked move stays in its current cell.
No sensors, physics or robot hardware.
Exploratory training return: means of 100 episodes
The primary model is seed 7, chosen in advance.
No evaluation episode updates Q or uses exploration.
Measured evaluation: 100 held-out noise seeds per policy and condition
Fixed-map experiment only. BFS is shortest without slip; it is not an optimal noisy-policy benchmark.
AI-assisted educational portfolio | Full results, uncertainty and training-seed variation: metrics.json
